title: Lightning Visuals — ICP / Anti-ICP Validation
summary: Validates Lightning Visuals' ICP assumptions against 92 closed HubSpot deals and proposes an ICP/anti-ICP scoring rubric, tiers, and enrichment plan for sign-off.
notes: Requirements/analysis doc driving a scoring rubric; competes with SPEC due to scoring point tables and property mappings, but has no API/schema contracts and is framed as product requirements pending sign-off, so classified PRD.
